decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Energy Statement, Transport Statement, Planning Statement, Design & Access Statement Location Plan, 1F-FA-01-TW4 5DP 00, 00-FA-01-TW4 5DP 00, 0G-FA-01-TW4 5DP 00 Received 17/02/2012 and Travel Plan (PMcL/3024d5/May 2012) Received 11/05/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use of the premises hereby permitted shall only be carried out between the hours of 08.30-18.00 Monday to Friday, 10.00-18.00 Saturday, Sunday and Public Holidays
Condition : 4 - Twenty-one parking spaces, including two disabled spaces shall be kept permanently available at the site for use by visitors and staff of the place of worship/community centre.
Condition : 5 - The windows and doors to the building shall remain closed outside of the hours 7.00am to 21.00pm any day of the week when the building is in use.
Condition : 6 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used internal to the building outside of the hours 7.00am to 21.00pm any day of the week.
Condition : 7 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used external to the building.

Condition : 8 - The Travel Plan (ref PMcL/3024d5/May 2012) shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the premises and thereafter maintained in association with the hereby consented use of the site.
description: Change of use from B1 (office/light industry) to D1 place of worship/community facility with ancillary education use
